Everything you need to get started — assessments, Unit 1, and the road ahead.

Start Here: The 15-Minute Foundation

Before diving into the units, we need to know where you're starting from. Two quick assessments — about 15 minutes total — create your baseline.

1

10x PMM Scorecard

Six questions about how you're using AI today in content creation. Takes 5 minutes. You'll see where you fall on the scale from "Pre-AI" to "10x PMM."

2

Where Do You Sit?

Discover your AI working style. Are you a Partner, a Catalyst, a Framer, or a Doer? This shapes how you'll approach the labs. Takes 10 minutes.

Unit 1: The Case for Change

Unit 1 lays the foundation. It answers the question: Why does product marketing need to change — and what does AI-era PMM actually look like?

What You'll Learn

  • How AI is reshaping the buyer journey (51% now start in ChatGPT)
  • The visibility gap: why traditional SEO isn't enough anymore
  • The 10x PMM framework: what separates AI-assisted from AI-native
  • Your first AI workflow audit

The Lab

Your first hands-on exercise: an AI workflow audit of your current toolkit. You'll inventory where you're already using AI, where you're not, and identify one workflow to upgrade.

The Quiz

Five questions covering the core concepts. Pass with 80% to complete the unit. You can retake as needed.

Pro tip: Don't rush the quiz. The concepts in Unit 1 build the foundation for everything that follows. Take notes on the reading — you'll reference them in later units.
